'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Matt Thornton DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thornton]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V) (Dark)|VB4-D-combatreadiness-pre.gif|label=Combat Readiness (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' DS Deck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
